theorem: Every acyclic Boolean circuit with g nonaffine binary gates admits an exhaustive, disjoint affine-original-input partition into at most 2^g cells, with every gate affine on each cell; previous compiler used 4^g.
primary_lower_bound: Braun 2026 arxiv:2609.23015 unrestricted DAG Res(XOR) bit-PHP > exp(n/(32768 ell^2)), ell>=32, n=2^ell, preprint not independently replayed.
target: unchanged Rmix341, one published proper proof subgrammar only
symbolic_proof: f(u,v)=c XOR alpha*u XOR beta*v XOR gamma*u*v. If gamma=1, branch on A=u=0/1, yielding c XOR alpha*a XOR (beta XOR a)*v. Induct over acyclic gate DAG.
conditional_transfer: S_ResXOR <= m+2^g*(m+2*r+2*x+sum_j 2^(k_j+1)+2) <= 2^(g+k*)*(4*m+8*q+8). Requires preexisting restricted branch-guard compiler.
conditioned_Braun: g+k*+log2(4m+8q+8)> n/(32768*ell^2*ln2). Only polynomial g=Omega(n/ell^2) when q polynomial and k* bounded.
